listed_quote.quote: Insight Select Income Fund (“INSI”) (NYSE: INSI), a closed-end investment company, entered into a definitive agreement under which KKR Income Opportunities Fund (NYSE: KIO), a closed-end investment company advised by KKR Credit Advisors (US) LLC, will acquire the assets of INSI.

announcement.quote: On October 8, 2024, it was announced that Insight Select Income Fund (“INSI”) (NYSE: INSI), a closed-end investment company, entered into a definitive agreement under which KKR Income Opportunities Fund (NYSE: KIO), a closed-end investment company advised by KKR Credit Advisors (US) LLC, will acquire the assets of INSI.

deals.notes: The N-8F (2025-03-07, reason: Merger) shows board approval 2024-10-03, shareholder approval 2025-01-10 and a distribution of assets in connection with the Merger, but the excerpt does not itself state that the merger was completed, so outcome is null.
